**Ludora - the Client for all Game Clients** · Release 0.7.5

### What's new
- **Stream tab:** games you can stream from another device are no longer greyed out – they look like installed games (with the **Stream** button and the device name).
- **Steam stays signed in:** you no longer have to sign in to Steam again and again. The Steam sign-in now stays on each device instead of being shared via your Ludora account – Steam replaces the token whenever it's renewed, which used to sign out your other devices. Ludora also no longer drops the sign-in after a temporary error; it simply tries again. After updating, sign in to Steam once per device (Friends → Steam).
- Epic and GOG sign-ins are still carried over to your other devices via your Ludora account.

### Downloads
| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `Ludora-Setup-0.7.5.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon M1–M4) | `Ludora-0.7.5-arm64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| macOS (Intel) | `Ludora-0.7.5-x64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| Linux (any distribution) | `Ludora-0.7.5-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `Ludora-0.7.5-amd64.deb` |

The files are not code-signed: on Windows click **More info → Run anyway**, on macOS **right-click → Open** on the first start.

**Deutsch:** Streambare Spiele im Reiter **„Stream“** sind nicht mehr ausgegraut. Die Steam-Anmeldung bleibt jetzt bestehen – sie gilt pro Gerät und wird nicht mehr über das Ludora-Konto geteilt (Steam tauscht das Token bei jeder Erneuerung aus und hat so die anderen Geräte abgemeldet). Nach dem Update einmal pro Gerät bei Steam anmelden (Freunde → Steam).
